claim_scope: 10000-image (5000-frame) OpenLORIS corridor1-1 tier, GT-free candidate generation/matching/admission; ground truth used only for the post-map score in stage B6. This is a pre-registered 10k-scale replication of m9-openloris-sparse-stereo-rank0-prefix-5000-v1's method (rank0-pair-prefix mapper guard + a stride-8 synchronized-stereo GT-free bridge over the frozen base's unregistered tail), run as Phase A (base-only frontier) + Phase B (targeted stereo8 bridge, frozen rank0 prefix).
background: The 5k experiment (m9-openloris-sparse-stereo-rank0-prefix-5000-v1) showed --rank0-pair-prefix admits a GT-free stride-8 stereo bridge without perturbing the frozen primary component. This step reruns the identical method at the full 10000-image (5000-frame) tier to see whether the approach scales: Phase A rebuilds the rig manifest and the base-only component frontier at 10k; Phase B derives targets from A2's own unregistered set (same start+every-8+run-end rule as the 5k run), generates/matches/reverifies a stride-8 stereo probe, merges it after the frozen base prefix, and maps with --rank0-pair-prefix. A lead review of the resulting score.json found that rank 0's fitted Sim(3) scale is far more degenerate at 10k (0.045) than at 5k (0.381), while the newly-registered stereo-seeded components (ranks 1-3) all have near-metric scale (0.968-0.991) -- meaning the large rank-0 aggregate error is a property of a base snapshot with almost no cross-sensor edges, not of the stereo8 method itself. A follow-on pre-registered arm C' (stereo8 admitted onto rank-0 frames too, no rank0 prefix, control = this file's B6) is running separately; see followup_arm_c_prime below.

analysis.source: lead's review of this step's score.json
analysis.finding: rank 0's fitted Sim(3) scale collapses to 0.045 at 10k (vs 0.381 at the 5k tier for the structurally equivalent rank-0 component), while the three stereo8-seeded components (ranks 1, 2, 3) all have near-metric scale: 0.968, 0.974, and 0.991 respectively. Rank 0 comes from the pre-existing base snapshot, which the 5k report's own pair-graph audit found has almost no cross-sensor (stereo) edges -- so rank 0's monocular-heavy track graph is essentially unconstrained in absolute scale and drifts further at 10k than it did at 5k. Because rank 0 also carries the largest share of gt_scored images (3174 of 8934, or 35.5%) and by far the largest per-image error (RMSE 5.69 m vs 0.41/0.15/0.07 m for ranks 1-3), it dominates the image-weighted aggregate: the reported aggregate RMSE of 3.400433 m is not evidence that the stereo8 method is inaccurate -- it is almost entirely rank 0's pre-existing scale drift being carried into the aggregate. The --rank0-pair-prefix guard, by construction, freezes and protects exactly this least-accurate component from any correction the added stereo edges might otherwise have supplied.
analysis.implication: the frozen rank0 prefix succeeds at its stated goal (registering 2880 more frames with zero risk of perturbing rank 0's existing tracks, all 5 pre-registered gates PASS), but as an accuracy result the aggregate number is misleading on its own: rank 0's 5.69 m RMSE is a scale-drift artifact of a base snapshot with almost no stereo edges, not a property of GT-free stereo8 bridging, which is what actually produces the near-metric ranks 1-3.

colmap_10k_control.alignment: one Sim(3) per disconnected model; image-weighted aggregate

context_not_gated.comparability_warning: this step's per-component independent Sim(3) alignment (4 separately-fitted gauges, one of them -- rank 0 -- badly scale-drifted) makes its 3.400433 m aggregate not directly comparable to either the COLMAP control's or the native E2E's numbers; those figures are recorded here purely for orientation, not as a benchmark comparison.

decision.outcome: all 4 applicable pre-registered gates (G1, G2, G4, G5) PASS; G3 is N/A because A2 produced no rank>=1 component to protect
decision.summary: Replicating the 5k rank0-pair-prefix stereo8 method at the full 10000-image tier registers 2880 additional frames (1933 -> 4813 of 5000, 809812 -> 811252 KiB peak RSS, a 1.0018x increase) via a GT-free, run-start+every-8+run-end stride-8 stereo probe re-verified under the frozen ratio-0.8 policy, merged strictly after the 58879-pair base prefix, and mapped with --rank0-pair-prefix. Rank 0 is provably unperturbed (byte-identical component-000 model files vs the base-only frontier). However, this step's own lead review found that rank 0's Sim(3) scale is severely degenerate at 10k (0.045, worse than 5k's already-poor 0.381) while all three stereo8-registered components have near-metric scale (0.968/0.974/0.991) -- so the reported aggregate RMSE (3.400433 m, p95 8.328011 m) is dominated by rank 0's pre-existing scale drift, not by the accuracy of the added stereo bridging. The frozen rank0 prefix, while safe by construction, therefore also protects the model's least accurate component from correction. This is recorded as a registration diagnostic step, not a benchmark result: no COLMAP-parity or README/registry promotion is made.
decision.not_claimed: COLMAP parity, wall-clock/performance superiority, held-out generalization beyond this development tier, or that the 3.400433 m aggregate is representative of the stereo8 method's own accuracy -- it is dominated by rank 0's unrelated scale drift

followup_arm_c_prime.rationale: the analysis above (see 'analysis') found that B6's large aggregate error is dominated by rank 0's own severe Sim(3) scale drift (0.045), which the --rank0-pair-prefix guard freezes and protects from correction; ranks 1-3 (registered via the stereo8 bridge) are all near-metric (0.968-0.991). Arm C' tests whether admitting the same GT-free stride-8 stereo bridge onto rank 0's own frames -- instead of only the base snapshot's unregistered tail -- lets rank 0's own scale correct itself when the mapper is run with all stereo8 edges visible to every rank (no rank0-pair-prefix).

decision.summary: Admitting the same GT-free, run-start+every-8+run-end stride-8 stereo bridge directly onto rank 0's own registered frames (245 targets, 231 pairs accepted after a GT-free dedup step, merged after B5's 59242-pair base-plus-stereo8.vps) and mapping WITHOUT --rank0-pair-prefix (so every rank sees all 59473 pairs) registers 3 more frames than control B6 (4816 vs 4813/5000) while cutting the aggregate RMSE from 3.400433 m to 0.236057 m (14.4x) and p95 from 8.328011 m to 0.459024 m (18.1x). Rank 0's own fitted Sim(3) scale, the root cause identified in B6's post-hoc analysis, moves from 0.045 (degenerate) to 0.989 (near-metric). Peak RSS at every stage stays under 2 GiB and is within 0.5% of B6's mapper peak. Determinism was independently reproduced: 14/14 model files byte-identical sha256 across a fresh repeat run, and score.json numerically identical after stripping root-path strings.
decision.current_10k_pipeline: arm C' (stereo8 edges admitted to all ranks, no --rank0-pair-prefix) is adopted as the current 10k development pipeline going forward. --rank0-pair-prefix remains a supported, tested mapper flag (added in 7ebc0ff, exercised by B6 and by the 5k rank0-prefix arm) but is NOT used in this adopted configuration -- it is retained as a tool for future arms that may specifically need a frozen/protected rank-0 prefix.
decision.not_claimed: COLMAP parity, wall-clock/performance superiority, or held-out generalization: see caveats below -- in particular caveat (a), this 10k tier is now a development set with respect to the rank0-scale hypothesis, so no accuracy claim should be made without an untouched holdout.

caveats.a: the arm C' hypothesis (admit the stereo8 bridge onto rank 0's own frames, no rank0-pair-prefix) was chosen after a lead inspected B6's post-hoc GT-derived Sim(3) scale (0.045) and diagnosed it as a pre-existing-graph property rather than a stereo8-method property. Candidate generation, matching, and admission for arm C' remained GT-free throughout (targets came from A2's own registered-frame runs, not from GT), but the *hypothesis itself* was informed by a GT-derived observation from a prior run on this same 10k tier. That makes this 10k tier a development set with respect to this specific hypothesis, even though no GT leaked into candidate/match/admission decisions. A performance claim (e.g. 'stereo8-on-rank0 beats COLMAP' or any README/registry promotion) requires re-running the same pre-registered method on an untouched OpenLORIS sequence/tier that was not used to form this hypothesis.
caveats.b: this arm's aggregate (component_weighted_rmse_m=0.23605684 m, p95=0.45902448 m) is a per-component independent Sim(3) alignment over 4 disconnected components and 8940 gt_scored images (9632 registered), using the same scorer convention as the COLMAP 10k control (benchmarks/electro/m8-openloris-colmap-10k-control.json: ate_rmse_m=0.3843065335437528 m, 2 disconnected models, 9306 gt_scored, 9998 registered) but NOT under equal conditions (different component count, different registered/scored image counts, independently-fitted gauges per component here vs there). No COLMAP-parity or COLMAP-win claim is made from this comparison; the COLMAP numbers are recorded for orientation only.
caveats.c: 184 frames are still unregistered after this arm (down from 187 in B6); the run list is in stage_c5_mapper.still_unregistered above, derived from this arm's own C6 mapper run (not reused from B6). This arm also still produces 4 separate components vs COLMAP's 2 -- component merging/bridging the remaining gaps is unaddressed follow-on work, not attempted here.
